venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: FAU had to stop Baugh or take away the hitch. They did neither.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — condensed rewrite for Charles. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: Florida made FAU choose all night: come down for Baugh, or sit and give Brown the hitch. They never chose. White’s people took the ball when Veltkamp waited. The 21 points are the three jobs they lost.

offense.body:
The first drive is the offense. Baugh for nine. Baugh for eight. Hitch to Brown for eight. Baugh for three. Philo loses two. Wilson for 19 down the left. Then first-and-10 at the FAU 49, corners still off, and Philo throws the hitch to Brown again. Catch at midfield. First man misses. Brown runs it in from 49. Seven plays, 94 yards, and Faulkner has already told you what he is doing. He is going to run Baugh until you come down. If you do not come down, he is going to throw it now.

Baugh already knows the play. When the hole dies he does not wait on it — left side, 18 yards, to the 25, and two snaps later Stockton is in the end zone from 12 on a ball caught at the 11. When they finally sit, third-and-2 at the Florida 33, he is gone 61 yards to the 6 and he finishes it himself from there. He scores from 12 through the middle and from 7 around the right. One hundred sixty yards. The line made that legal. Harris is the left guard. Lovett, Moore, Shanahan, and Ugorji are the rest of the first five. You can see them move people on the give and you can see Baugh still have a bounce when the first crease closes. The tight ends and the wideouts are in that run too. They are not standing around. Stockton’s score, Brown’s 14-yard carry to the left, Harpring’s 19 up the middle — the skill guys are finishing blocks and catching the ball that is there.

Philo’s job is to run that count, not to invent a new one. Sixteen of 21. He is in and out. Hitch. Hitch. Wilson again for 15 after FAU has just scored. Fourth-and-1 at his own 49, he takes it himself for the first, Harpring gets 19, and Baugh punches the 12-yarder. That is a quarterback operating. The other side of it is the one time he holds it. Third-and-7 at the FAU 44, 37 seconds left in the half. Sweeney is sitting. The ball is his. Clark is the one who has to make the tackle on the return.

They do not live in a dropback. They mix the downhill give with the bounce and the stretch. The shot is the exception, and it only exists because the run was real. FAU has just gone 75 yards and walked in from the 1. Second-and-6 from the Florida 29, extra bodies stay in to stop Baugh, and Abrams runs by everybody for 63 to the 8. Then Florida almost gives it back — a snap that loses 20 — and Baugh gets 25 of it back to the 3. Philo takes it in himself from there. That is the night too. They survive their own mess because the back is still the play.

Clark is not a change-of-pace cameo. After Dijon Johnson’s interception he rips 15 around the right and 7 through the middle, and Baugh finishes from the 7. In the fourth he takes it 28 to the 6 and punches it from the 4. The 10-yard touchdown in the third is the same idea as Brown’s hitch. They sit for the run. Clark releases. Catch at the 4. He drives it in.

Brown is the one who turns the rhythm throw into a stadium play. The 49. The 33 down the right later. The 18 on third-and-11 to the 10 that sets up Clark. Forty snaps. If Campbell comes down, Baugh will eat. If Campbell sits, that is the man they will throw it to.
bullets: The first drive is the whole offense: Baugh until they sit, hitch when they do.
Philo runs the count. When he holds it, Sweeney is sitting.
Clark is a runner. The release score is what happens when they finally stop the run with their eyes.
They mix downhill and bounce. They do not live in a dropback.

defense.body:
White’s deal is also a count. Four down. Extra defensive back on the slot. Corners off. Rush four. Give them the short throw. Tackle it. If Veltkamp holds it, go get the ball.

FAU’s first series is that deal in the other direction. Short left. Short left. Convert. Convert. They live in the five-and-seven-yard game because the corners are not going to get beat over the top. Then third-and-10 at the Florida 35, the ball stays in the air, and Coleman is standing at the 5. Drive over. Same deal, first snap after Baugh’s 12-yard score: Veltkamp from his own 25, off his back foot, Johnson goes up and gets it at the 30, Coleman is on the breakup. They will give you Henry and Valsin underneath. They will not give you the one you hold.

They come downhill to do it. Graham is in the picture on the run and on the rush. Chiles is with him. McCloud hurries Veltkamp into misses. Lyons shows up where the tape actually puts him — he and Flowers drop Messer for a loss on the first snap after Stockton scores, and later he and Graham share a sack. James is the other one. He drops Farrow for a loss of three at the 7. He sacks Veltkamp into a fumble they do not recover. He hurries him in the fourth. He is the tackle on fourth down at the end of the half. That is not a depth-chart mention. That is the front.

The 21 points are three lost jobs.

The pile: first-and-goal at the 1. White packs it. No bounce. Ervin still walks in. The call was right. They lost a yard they cannot lose.

The quarterback run: James has just made the stop, third-and-goal at the 7, and Veltkamp keeps it himself and walks in. Same rush. The end has to stay outside. He does not. That is the scramble they ate.

The fade: they have been sitting off all night. First-and-10 at the Florida 20, Valsin releases, stacks Flowers, wins the back line, 20 yards. If you sit to kill the deep ball, you have to win that one when they throw it.

The rush finally finishes the night the way White drew it. Fourth-and-goal at the 1, Veltkamp keeps left, Bett gets there, ball out at the 5, Myles Johnson falls on it at the 11. They had already taken two from the air. They took the last one off his hip.

Campbell will throw the short one and run the quarterback. Same deal. Tackle the hitch. Keep the end at home.
bullets: Give them the short throw. Coleman and Johnson take the one he holds.
James and Lyons are on the tape — TFL, sack, hurry — not a mention from the two-deep.
The 21 points are the pile, the quarterback run, and the fade.
Campbell: hitch and the keep. Tackle it. Stay outside.

specials.body: Fourth-and-4 from the FAU 35. They can go for it. Durkin makes it from 53. 17–0. Florida never punts. They took the points when the drive stalled and they never gave the ball back on fourth down.
bullets: Durkin from 53. They took the points.

keys: FAU had to stop Baugh or take away the hitch. They did neither.
Philo runs that count. The Sweeney ball is the one time he does not.
White gives them the short throw and takes the held ball. James and Lyons show up in that rush.
The 21 points are the pile, the keep, and the fade. Campbell will run the quarterback.

nextWeek.look: They will go fast and throw hitch. Faulkner will still run Baugh until they sit. White will still rush four. Tackle the short one. Keep the end at home.
